name: Hangzhou Qiandaohu Xunlong Sci-tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Hangzhou Qiandaohu Xunlong Sci-tech Co., Ltd. processes, produces, markets, and exports caviar in China and internationally. The company offers caviar-based products, such as hybrid sturgeon, Russian sturgeon, kaluga caviar, beluga caviar, amur sturgeon caviar, and Siberian sturgeon caviar, as well as sturgeon meat and processed sturgeon products. It also provides upstream breeding, aquaculture activities, and downstream processing services. It sells its products through the internet and offline channels.
